source.title: Rebuilding U.S. Missile Inventory: A Multiyear Project

summary: CSIS follow-up on how long each munition takes to return to prewar levels, using FY2027 budget requests and DoD delivery schedules. Source for most of the rebuild model's delivery dates.

claims.quote: A CNN report citing DOD sources indicated that actual Standard Missile usage in Operation Epic Fury was closer to the lower-bound estimates in the CSIS munitions inventory study
A CNN report citing DOD sources indicated that actual Standard Missile usage in Operation Epic Fury was closer to the lower-bound estimates in the CSIS munitions inventory study
Thus, while over 1,100 JASSMs were expended, U.S. inventories will recover fairly quickly as past orders are delivered.
Accordingly, use has been limited—though highly effective—and replacing expenditures will take only a few months.
